---
title: "Mallard Duck Movement"
author: "GitHub Copilot"
format: html
---

This page documents mallard duck movement over time.

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

duck_data <- data.frame(
  day = 1:5,
  ducks = c(12, 18, 25, 20, 31)
)

ggplot(duck_data, aes(day, ducks)) +
  geom_line(color = "#2b7a78") +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "#2b7a78") +
  labs(
    title = "Mallard Duck Counts",
    x = "Day",
    y = "Number of ducks"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
